refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: OLS applies to the multivariate model y = x*b + e with mean (e) = 0 and cov (vec (e)) = kron (s, I). where y is a t by p matrix, x is a t by k matrix, b is a k by p matrix, and e is a t by p matrix. Each row of y and x is an observation and each column a variable. The return values beta, sigma, and r are defined as follows.

listitem.para: The OLS estimator for b. beta is calculated directly via inv (x'*x) * x' * y if the matrix x'*x is of full rank. Otherwise, beta = pinv (x) * y where pinv (x) denotes the pseudoinverse of x.
The OLS estimator for the matrix s, sigma = (y-x*beta)'* (y-x*beta) / (t-rank(x))
The matrix of OLS residuals, r = y - x*beta.
